hypothesis: Individual bounded selectors improve aggregate and user-macro consistently but a minority of boundary changes vary by initialization. Unanimous three-seed routing suppresses initialization-dependent changes without selecting a favorable seed.
training: Unchanged branch_selector fixed recipe. Deployment members2026,2027,2028 already fitted before consensus design; replication members2029,2030,2031 newly fitted after locking this record.
routing: Run three bounded selectors. Change baseline only when all three select the same class different from baseline; otherwise retain exact baseline logits. No vote/weight/threshold scan.
limitations: Exploratory adaptive model design on reused meta-OOF; new seeds only check initialization stability, not independent data generalization. Target-pretrained upstream limitation remains. Private-LB gain is not guaranteed.
stopping_rule: A single unanimity rule; no majority/meanprobability scan, changing membership, retraining recipe, or selective subgroup overrides. No fullfit/test/submission unless consensus gates pass.
